title: Women in AI: Connecting on Innovation, Change, and Impact
description:
This table talk creates an opportunity for women to connect and share what’s on your mind as AI continues to reshape the way we work. The conversation will explore perspectives on AI development, tooling, and innovation. It will also examine the broader change and transformation driven by AI and where women see the greatest opportunities to influence its future.

Seating for this session is first-come, first-served. Add it to your schedule to plan your day and arrive early to secure a spot.
